summary: Two OMP boot canaries prove that an unanswered ask returns with the same session, tool-call id, question and options after the daemon is stopped with SIGTERM or SIGKILL, with no model turn or person action in between.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, wire or harness change; only the boot canary fixture, its OMP provider stand-in and crates/fractal/tests/boot_canaries.rs change. The new canaries fall under the existing daily-only boot_canaries filter.
